newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt o/n rates stable, one week narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt o/n rates stable, one week narrow.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were unchanged at seven and 8-1/2 percent in a liquid private sector market on Wednesday, bankers said.
One-week rates narrowed to between seven and eight percent from Tuesday's range of seven and 8-3/4 percent, they added.
Bankers say the current liquidity will help push interest rates down.
"This level of interest rates does not encourage people to invest," said one banker. "The reasonable level is around nine-ten percent for borrowers."
Bankers said that public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
